note: World-space colliders generated from level.json shapes. Godot: BoxShape3D / CylinderShape3D / ConvexPolygonShape3D / HeightMapShape3D (cell size = 'cell'). Hazards are areas (Area3D), not solid. Triggers (level exits) are areas too.

triggers.note: walking into the black at the end of the exit hallway loads the next level (Construct Error: handle in the level_exit trigger)

entrances.note: the player appears here, walking out of the black hallway

gates.note: Construct Error: a StaticBody3D blocker stands here while closed (apply_mobile.gd); call open_gate(id) when the encounter's last wave is cleared - the beams fade out, the blocker goes, signal gate_opened(id).
